likelihoodChoice.note: one-step GPS predictability prefers sigma_white at the grid minimum (0.02 m) and no slow-error state: the 10 Hz fixes are internally smooth (receiver-filtered), so the likelihood cannot separate a slow GPS error from motion

shippedMovingAverageCornerCut.theory: centred 5-point mean of 10 Hz positions on an arc: inward offset = a_lat * dt^2 * sum(k^2)/(2*5) = a_lat * 0.01 s^2
shippedMovingAverageCornerCut.meaning: the shipped lat/lng (5-point moving average) put the car inside the GPS arc by ~0.011 s^2 x a_lat (~0.13 m at 1.25 g); the likelihood-tuned GNSS+IMU smoother differs from the shipped path by exactly this term plus ~5 mm RMS
